_curation.note: Hand-curated. `id` is the stable Claude Code request value (model_selection = alias). label/description/ratings written by a human from the current lineup. The live harness can add or remove context-hinted variants as account access changes, so the catalog uses the stable bare id the runner can widen to a `[1m]` option when available. Current lineup: Claude Fable 5.1 is the frontier, Claude Opus 5.5 is the recommended default one tier below it. The pinned Claude Code build no longer offers `claude-fable-5` as a selectable model (it offers `claude-fable-5-1`, or `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` on subscription accounts), so Fable 5 is not listed. Ratings: 1-5, higher is better; `cost` is cost-efficiency (5 = cheapest).
_curation.sources: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.280 accepted set; Anthropic models overview + pricing pages, checked 2026-09-22.
